description: Rank every company that reported one financial fact in one period, from the SEC's own XBRL frames API: revenue, assets, liabilities, net income, diluted EPS, equity, cash or operating cash flow, for a named calendar period. Each row carries the CIK, the entity name, the value, the period end and the accession number that reported it. EDGAR content is public domain and free to reuse, so the screen is sellable without any data licence. Choose this to rank every United States filer that reported one financial fact in one period, when you need reported values with the accession number that carries each one, from public-domain Government data rather than a licensed market feed. Do not choose this for share prices, market capitalisation or valuation ratios (it carries reported financial facts, not market data), for non-US filers, or for a time series across periods (one screen is one period). Example requests: Screen US companies by revenue for CY2025Q4I and give me the top 20. | Which filers reported the largest total assets last quarter? Rank them. | Rank companies by diluted EPS for CY2025Q4 with the accession number for each.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

direction.description: Optional: 'desc' (largest first, the default) or 'asc' (smallest first).

metric.description: The financial fact to rank on: revenue, assets, liabilities, net_income, eps, equity, cash or operating_cash_flow. Supply 'tag' and 'unit' instead to screen an arbitrary us-gaap tag.

period.description: The EDGAR frame period: 'CY2024Q4' for a quarter's duration, 'CY2024' for a year, or 'CY2024Q4I' for an instant (a balance).

rows.description: Optional: how many companies to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

tag.description: Optional: an exact us-gaap tag to screen instead of a friendly metric, such as 'ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense'.

unit.description: Optional: the unit for an exact tag, such as 'USD' or 'USD/shares'. Default USD.
